name: Show hidden files and folders
description: Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer (View > Show > Hidden items) by setting Hidden = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced. Protected operating system files stay hidden: ShowSuperHidden is not changed.
rationale: Optional preference for users who work with configuration folders such as AppData; it makes files that applications hide visible and reviewable.
effects: File Explorer shows items that have the Hidden attribute (for example the AppData folder).
sideEffects: Folders show additional items that applications store hidden; deleting or moving them by mistake can break those applications.
Protected operating system files remain hidden because ShowSuperHidden is not modified.
notes: Windows default: Hidden = 2 (hidden items are not shown). WinLean restores whatever value was recorded before applying the rule.
Microsoft's Microsoft.Windows.Developer DSC module (WindowsExplorer resource) uses Hidden = 1 for 'Show'.
Not part of Safe or Lean: it is a personal preference rather than an optimization. See Profiles/Example.Custom.json.
